simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לָאט (H3814) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: לָאט (lâʼṭ) means properly, muffled , i.e. silently First listed occurrence: Judg 4 21.

definitions.full: H3814. lat לָאט Judg 4:21 , etc., see לוּט . לָאט לָּט, noun [masculine] secrecy, mystery ; — absolute לָט 1Sam 18:22 2 t., לָאט Judg 4:21 ; plural suffix לָטֵיהֶם Exod 7:22 2 t.; לַהֲטֵיהֶם 7:11 ; — always with ׃בְּ 1 בַּלָּט = secretly 1Sam 18:22 ; 24:5 ; Ruth 3:7 ; so בַּלָּאט Judg 4:21 . 2 בְּלָטֵיהֶם with their mysteries = enchantments (i. e. of מִצְרַיִם חַרְטֻמֵּי ) Exod 7:22 ; 8:3 ; 8:14 = בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶם 7:11 (all P).
